statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-5598 (GHSA-p93r-85wp-75v3): the FrodoKEM implementation in Bouncy Castle bcprov did not run in constant time when it sampled error values and compared results during decapsulation, a timing side channel that can leak the private key; only users of FrodoKEM are affected. Bouncy Castle lists 1.71 to 1.80.1, 1.81 and 1.82 to 1.83 as affected and 1.80.2, 1.81.1 and 1.84 as fixed (https://github.com/bcgit/bc-java/wiki/CVE%E2%80%902026%E2%80%905598, https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-p93r-85wp-75v3; fix commits https://github.com/bcgit/bc-java/commit/94abbd56413dfdac651fd878bc60253871ef5e87 and https://github.com/bcgit/bc-java/commit/8692e6b2b191fc4aafa32545c7a78bdb9bf110c5, both in the r1rv84 release tag and not in r1rv83). The DHI gradle-8 package ships Bouncy Castle as jars in /usr/share/java/gradle/lib/plugins. We read every published gradle-8 package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository as listed in its index on 2026-11-28 (16 versions, 8.14.4-r0 to 8.14.8-r0), after checking each package against its index checksum and size; the aarch64 package of each version has the same index checksum as the x86_64 one, and 8.14.5-r4 is published for x86_64 only. We opened every jar in each package, nested jars included. Bouncy Castle classes appear only in the bcprov-jdk18on, bcpg-jdk18on and bcutil-jdk18on jars, with no relocated copy in any other jar, and only the bcprov jar contains the FrodoKEM classes. Each bcprov jar is byte for byte the Maven Central release named in its file name: 1.78.1 in 8.14.4-r0 to 8.14.4-r3, 1.84 in 8.14.5-r3 to 8.14.5-r8 and 1.85 in 8.14.5-r9 to 8.14.8-r0. The 1.84 and 1.85 jars contain the constant-time sampler the fix adds (org.bouncycastle.pqc.crypto.frodo.Noise, in both the base and the Java 9 multi-release copy); the 1.78.1 jar does not. The range ends at 8.14.5-r3, the first build with bcprov-jdk18on 1.84.
